elements.element: Transition assistance provided by Vendor on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance duration up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date
return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data of the Company then in HDI's possession or control

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Return within 30 days (running from expiry/termination, not a request)
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date
(c) thereafter delete all such Content, user information and customer data from its systems
certify such deletion to the Company in writing
up to six (6) months following the Termination Date (exceeds 90 days)
within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data

reasons: The inserted Section 4.3 supplies every atomic element of the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Company Content/user information/customer data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of the Termination Date, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

The request condition attaches only to transition assistance; the data-return, deletion and certification duties remain mandatory and run from the Termination Date, so the recurring 'request condition swallowing data return' boundary is not crossed.

The Agreement was silent on exit, so a single concise new subsection is the minimal fix; no existing term, term/termination mechanic or Termination Payment provision is altered and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Minor softeners ('reasonable' assistance, 'at the Company's request') do not defeat any preferred element and are within customary drafting for the inserted clause.
